headline: King George V and Queen Mary Crowned in Splendour at Westminster Abbey
dispatch: King George V received the crown of Great Britain and Ireland at Westminster Abbey yesterday in a ceremony of ancient pageantry attended by heads of state and royalty from across Europe. Archbishop Randall Davidson placed St Edward's Crown upon the king's head before a packed congregation of peers, diplomats, and dignitaries. Queen Mary was crowned immediately after in a rite unchanged in its essentials for centuries.
answer: King George V crowned at Westminster Abbey, 1911
